verdict.rationale: Gladia documents getting transcription results in open formats: SRT/VTT subtitle export, and CLI output as plain text, JSON, SRT or VTT. That lets a user take their transcript data out in portable formats. There is no evidence of a bulk export of all account data or of a documented account-exit or offboarding path. Missing for 10: bulk export of all stored data/history, documented account deletion/exit process, independent corroboration.
